name: rust-service
title: Rust service: axum + tokio + sqlx + Postgres
summary: Rust stable (2021 or 2024 edition) HTTP service: axum on tokio, sqlx with compile-time checked queries and SQL migrations, Postgres, cargo test, rustfmt + clippy, optional cargo-deny/cargo-audit, multi-stage Dockerfile, deployed as an image to Fly.io, Cloud Run, or Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI.
recommended_for: a backend API or worker where latency, memory footprint, and a compiler that checks the SQL matter more than a paved front-end road
not_for: server-rendered web apps with heavy UI, teams without Rust experience, or prototypes that will change shape weekly

commands.e2e: cargo test --test '*' (integration tests under tests/; #[sqlx::test] needs DATABASE_URL)
commands.query_cache: cargo sqlx prepare (writes .sqlx/; cargo sqlx prepare --check in CI)
commands.migrate_run: sqlx migrate run (dev, CI, staging only)
commands.migrate_prod: <scripts/migrate-prod.sh> (confirmation-gated wrapper around sqlx migrate run; see WORKFLOW.md)
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI builds the image tagged with the SHA and rolls it out; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: cargo fmt (rustfmt; rustfmt.toml optional, detected by post-edit-format.sh)
migration_tool: sqlx-cli (plain SQL under migrations/, timestamp version prefix; watermark = _sqlx_migrations.version, checksum verified on every run)
date_helpers: src/util/time.rs (now_utc, parse_date; chrono or time, UTC at rest, TIMESTAMPTZ in Postgres)
app_verifier_boot: cargo run (binds <HOST>:<PORT>, default 0.0.0.0:8080), then drive the changed routes with curl or an integration test under tests/

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules (no ui rule; delete the core ui.md or scope it to nothing)
overlay.qa_pack: none (drive deployed targets with curl or an integration test binary; see WORKFLOW.md)
